quarterly_data.quarter: ADEKA earnings release: Consolidated Financial Results for the Three Months Ended June 30, 2026 (08-07-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Semiconductor Materials: sales of high-k materials were strong for both key products and new products, driven by expanding production of advanced DRAM fueled by AI-related demand; sales of lithography materials for advanced photoresists were strong on expanding EUV adoption. Profit rose on volume and foreign exchange, partly offset by fixed costs.
quarterly_data.figure: Semiconductor Materials net sales 108 (100 million yen), +47.2%; operating profit 26 (100 million yen), +82.9%

quarterly_data.quarter: ADEKA earnings release: Consolidated Financial Results for the Three Months Ended June 30, 2026 (08-07-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Other segments: Polymer Additives sales rose on PVC stabilizers for home interiors and wire coating (helped by US data-center investment), clarifiers and antioxidants; Environmental Materials sales rose on special epoxy resins for semiconductor encapsulation materials, lubricant additives and reactive emulsifiers; Life Science sales rose on agrochemicals.
quarterly_data.figure: Polymer Additives 287 (+14.5%); Environmental Materials 232 (+16.9%); Life Science 310 (+14.6%) (100 million yen)
